topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 91 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 22 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs, 1 Chainlink feed; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
